question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word: **Rancor**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Animosity**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Rancor"** refers to a deep-seated bitterness, resentment, or ill will, especially of a long-lasting nature. (कटुता, शत्रुता)
 
 
• **Example:** Even after years, she still felt rancor toward her old rival.
 
 
• **"Animosity"** means strong hostility or hatred, which is very similar to "rancor" in meaning. (द्वेष)
 
 
• **Example:** The animosity between the two neighbors was evident during the meeting.
 
 
• Therefore, "Animosity" is the most appropriate synonym for "Rancor."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Animosity**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Amity** (मित्रता): Friendly relations between people or countries.
 
 
• **Example:** The treaty brought amity between the two warring nations.
 
 
 
• **Goodwill** (सद्भावना): Kindness or a friendly attitude towards others.
 
 
• **Example:** The company donated to charity to show its goodwill toward the community.
 
 
 
• **Harmony** (सामंजस्य): A pleasing arrangement of parts or a peaceful coexistence.
 
 
• **Example:** The family lived in harmony despite their differences.
